lines.text: Count by tens from zero, then look between the marks.
Tap the line where 100 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 13 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 15 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 3 point 2 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 45 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 9 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where negative 1 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where one third goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where the square root of 38 goes. Then launch!
The marks count by 25. Tap the line where negative 84 goes. Then launch!
